item.name: Default
item.cardSummary: The unmutated Brainrot form with its normal income rate.
item.acquisition: Any Brainrot without another mutation uses the Default form.
item.visualEffect: Keeps the Brainrot's original colors and effects.

item.name: Gold
item.cardSummary: A permanent gold variant that raises the Brainrot's income by 25%.
item.acquisition: Has a 10% chance to appear on a Brainrot spawning on the Red Carpet.
item.visualEffect: Changes the Brainrot to a yellow-gold color.

item.name: Diamond
item.cardSummary: A permanent cyan variant with a 1.5× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Has a 5% chance to appear on a Brainrot spawning on the Red Carpet.
item.visualEffect: Gives the Brainrot a cyan, diamond-like appearance.

item.name: Rainbow
item.cardSummary: A permanent color-cycling mutation with a 10× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Has a 1% Red Carpet spawn chance, with improved odds during the Rainbow Machine event.
item.visualEffect: Cycles the Brainrot through red, green, and blue colors.

item.name: Bloodrot
item.cardSummary: The dark-red mutation introduced with the Bloodmoon event.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Bloodmoon event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Changes the Brainrot to a dark-red color.

item.name: Candy
item.cardSummary: A pink event mutation with a 4× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Candy Aurora event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Changes the Brainrot to a bright pink color.

item.name: Lava
item.cardSummary: A molten orange event mutation with a 6× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Molten event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Changes the Brainrot to a neon orange, molten color.

item.name: Galaxy
item.cardSummary: A neon-purple seasonal mutation with a 7× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Galactic event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Changes the Brainrot to a neon purple color.

item.name: Yin Yang
item.cardSummary: A black-and-white event mutation with a 7.5× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Yin-Yang event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Splits the Brainrot's appearance into black and white colors.

item.name: Radioactive
item.cardSummary: A neon-green event mutation with an 8.5× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Radioactive event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Adds neon-green coloring and a hatched radioactive texture.

item.name: Cursed
item.cardSummary: A red-and-black mutation from the Cursed event with a 9× multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Cursed event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Adds red-and-black coloring, red symbols, glowing eyes, and matching effects.

item.name: Divine
item.cardSummary: A bright celestial mutation that shares Rainbow's 10× multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Divine event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Adds bright yellow-white coloring and a layer of white symbols.

item.name: Cyber
item.cardSummary: A black-and-blue cybernetic mutation with an 11× income multiplier.
item.acquisition: Was applied during the Cyber event and now depends on Admin Abuse or special reruns.
item.visualEffect: Adds black-and-blue coloring with transparent, neon, and cybernetic-patterned areas.

item.name: Phantom
item.cardSummary: A dark spectral mutation with the highest listed mutation multiplier.
item.acquisition: Can be applied to Brainrots spawning while the Phantom event is active.
item.visualEffect: Makes the Brainrot translucent black, with flickering transparency and rapidly flashing white features.
